summary: Full backend + frontend regression for RoutY MVP. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass (public root, routes list, route detail w/ ETAs, live movement, nearest stop, bus by id, search known (R2) & unknown (demand logging), SOS + resolve flow with bus flagging, translate+cache, admin auth, admin overview/sos/demand, full route lifecycle create/add bus/history/soft-delete, unauth 401s, wrong password 401, WS /api/ws/live snapshot + push). Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): Map tab loads, language toggle switches EN<->HI, Live pill shows 'Live · 10 buses live', bottom card + Use my location + SOS confirm sheet all work. Search modal known pair returns R2 result, tapping navigates to route detail with stops+ETA+announce+track; unknown pair shows empty state. Routes tab lists R1-R4, filter narrows to R2, route detail opens. Settings has EN/HI, audio toggle, Test voice, Admin access. Admin login: wrong password shows error, correct login opens Control room dashboard with 4/10/0/2 stats after query settles, live map, SOS/bunching sections. Nav tiles to Manage routes, Route replay, Demand heatmap all reachable. Logout returns to /settings. No deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch). No React Native red screen. Only console noise: harmless RN Web warnings about shadow* and pointerEvents style props (framework-level).
action_items: None required — MVP passes all requested backend and frontend flows.
Optional: consider showing a skeleton/loader for stat tiles instead of an em-dash during the first ~1s while /api/admin/overview loads (cosmetic only).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py well-structured, uses env vars, excludes _id in all Mongo reads, proper 401/404/400 codes.
Admin lifecycle endpoints are guarded via AdminDep; unauth requests return 401 as verified in tests.
SIM engine ticks every 2s and pushes to WS subscribers; verified two consecutive snapshots received over wss://.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from api.ts; no hardcoded URLs found. testIDs are present across all interactive elements.
seed_data_creation: Test route with prefix TR<hex> and TEST_Stop_* created and soft-deleted during test_route_lifecycle; two unmet-search demand rows inserted (from tests + earlier UI test with ZZZTown/YYYPlace and Nowhereville/MadeUpTown). No cleanup needed for these (demand is a designed side-effect and doesn't affect user flows).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py can be re-run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. Admin login is form-urlencoded at POST /api/admin/login. WebSocket URL is wss://<host>/api/ws/live. If demand_count/unmet_searches drifts, that's expected because search endpoint intentionally logs demand for unknown pairs.
